import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

repository = pathlib.Path.cwd()
cases = {
    'comment': (\"# eval('1 + 1')\\n\", 0),
    'string': ('value = \"eval(\\'1 + 1\\')\"\\n', 0),
    'method': ('result = obj.eval(\"1 + 1\")\\n', 0),
    'direct builtin': ('result = eval(\"1 + 1\")\\n', 1),
    'nested builtin': ('def compute():\\n    return eval(\"1 + 1\")\\n', 1),
}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eval-check-') as directory:
    workspace = pathlib.Path(directory)
    shutil.copy2(repository / 'check.py', workspace / 'check.py')
    shutil.copy2(repository / 'checks.json', workspace / 'checks.json')
    source = workspace / 'src' / 'nested' / 'example.py'
    source.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    for label, (code, expected_status) in cases.items():
        source.write_text(code)
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'check.py'], cwd=workspace, capture_output=True, text=True)
        expected_output = 'src/nested/example.py\\n' if expected_status else '\\n'
        assert result.returncode == expected_status, (label, result.returncode, result.stderr)
        assert result.stdout == expected_output, (label, result.stdout)
        print(f'PASS: {label}')
pathlib.Path(__file__).unlink()
PY
python3 \""'$verification_script"'
